$reader = New-Object System.Xml.XmlNodeReader $xaml
$window = [Windows.Markup.XamlReader]::Load($reader)

$names = @('BrandLogo','StatusBadge','PcText','CpuText','RamText','GpuText','WindowsText','InternetText','ProfileCombo',
  'ChromeCheck','FirefoxCheck','SevenZipCheck','VlcCheck','PdfCheck','LibreOfficeCheck','ZoomCheck','DiscordCheck','SteamCheck','EpicCheck','EaCheck','UbisoftCheck','BattleNetCheck','GogCheck','ObsCheck','VcX64Check','VcX86Check','DirectXCheck',
  'AppsCheck','UpdatesCheck','DriversCheck','GpuHelperCheck','DiagnosticCheck','InstallSenetechButton','OpenInstallFolderButton','InstallAfterPrepCheck','DeploymentStatusText','ModeHeaderText','CacheButton','ExportDriversButton','AutoCacheCheck','OfflineStatusText','LogBox','Progress','FooterText','UpdateButton','AnalyzeButton','ReportButton','RestartButton','StartButton')
foreach ($name in $names) { Set-Variable -Name $name -Value $window.FindName($name) -Scope Script }

function Update-DeploymentUi {
    if ($script:IsInstalledMode) {
        $script:ModeHeaderText.Text = 'MODE INSTALLE'
        $script:ModeHeaderText.Foreground = '#7DD3A7'
        $script:DeploymentStatusText.Text = ('Mode installe : SENETECH est installe dans {0}. Les futures mises a jour continueront de venir du meme GitHub.' -f $script:Root)
        $script:InstallSenetechButton.Visibility = [System.Windows.Visibility]::Collapsed
        $script:InstallAfterPrepCheck.Visibility = [System.Windows.Visibility]::Collapsed
        $script:OpenInstallFolderButton.Visibility = [System.Windows.Visibility]::Visible
    } else {
        $script:ModeHeaderText.Text = 'MODE PORTABLE'
        $script:ModeHeaderText.Foreground = '#8BA3B8'
        $script:DeploymentStatusText.Text = 'Mode portable : SENETECH fonctionne depuis ce dossier ou une cle USB. Vous pouvez l installer sur ce PC sans perdre le mode portable.'
        $script:InstallSenetechButton.Visibility = [System.Windows.Visibility]::Visible
        $script:InstallAfterPrepCheck.Visibility = [System.Windows.Visibility]::Visible
        $script:OpenInstallFolderButton.Visibility = [System.Windows.Visibility]::Collapsed
    }
}

function New-BrandBitmap([string]$Path) {
    $bitmap = New-Object System.Windows.Media.Imaging.BitmapImage
    $bitmap.BeginInit()
    $bitmap.CacheOption = [System.Windows.Media.Imaging.BitmapCacheOption]::OnLoad
    $bitmap.UriSource = New-Object System.Uri -ArgumentList $Path
    $bitmap.EndInit()
    $bitmap.Freeze()
    return $bitmap
}

try {
    $brandAssetDir = Join-Path $script:EngineDir 'Assets'
    $logoPath = Join-Path $brandAssetDir 'SENETECH-Logo.png'
    $windowIconPath = Join-Path $brandAssetDir 'SENETECH-Icon.png'
